title: The Axis — one continuous three.js instrument holding nine āvaraṇas as weather up the body
what: One continuous three.js instrument, The Axis, holds the nine āvaraṇas as weather stacked up the body (Feet → Totality, 30 units apart) and all 102 Śaktis as points of light standing in their rings. Tapping a light begins the rite of entering, which is itself the travel.
how: Single 3D scene; rings stacked on a vertical axis 30 units apart; each Śakti a point of light; tap → rite → flight → her room; 'rise' carries you up through the nine worlds.
needs: SceneKit/RealityKit or Metal port of homes-3d-core.js; ShaktiCard data; RingWorld
notes: Design prototype only (JS). Ruling 3: Axis = chakra 18. Ruling 15: Climb's 102 lights stay alike.

title: Rite of entering = the travel (three self-paced beats, three surges of flight)
what: Three self-paced beats (her phrase · her Devanāgarī written by an unseen hand · her roots parting and rejoining over her quality) carry you in three surges of flight until her world's fog swallows everything and the point becomes her room. 'The rite is the distance.' 'Self-paced by touch — never a timer, never skipped, compressed on return.'
how: Each tap advances one beat and one stretch of flight toward her; fog of her world closes; the point becomes the room. On return the beats are compressed via HomeMemory.compression.
needs: ShaktiCard.phrase, dev, roots, quality; stroke-order Devanāgarī rendering; HomeView.swift
notes: Brief: 'Three beats, a few seconds, never skipped, never lingered on.'

title: Room clock: first adaptation 62 s, hold to 227 s, second adaptation reverses premise over 120 s
what: Each room is a mechanism (not a palette) that runs on real elapsed seconds — a first adaptation over 62 s, a hold to 227 s (a 165 s hold), and a second adaptation that reverses the room's premise over 120 s, reachable in practice only through accumulated dwell. RoomState.adaptation 0→1 over 62s; RoomState.second 0→1 over 120s after a 165s hold. 'Every room reverses its premise at the second adaptation. Not more of the same — a reversal.'
how: RoomMechanism.state(at t) → RoomState{adaptation, second, transforms}; label(at t) gives near words and words past second adaptation.
needs: Rooms/RoomMechanism.swift protocol; elapsed-time clock per room
notes: 227 − 62 = 165. 'stay' control runs her clock 14× in prototype.

title: Held attribute as the room's one actor
what: Her Iconography line becomes the room's one actor: a shape performing the single action it exists to perform. Aniconic — a noose is a shape, not a figure. 26 forms; 52 named across the 102. Past the second adaptation the attribute stops being an object — grows into the room (0.9 → 3.16) and thins.
how: ATTRIBUTE map pos→key (52 distinct keys) → one of 26 built forms; ATTR_TINT tints the actor; scale grows with second adaptation.
needs: Rooms/Attribute.swift; ATTRIBUTE + ATTR_TINT from homes-cards.js; 26 form geometries
notes: Code reaches 0.9+2.6=3.5 at full second adaptation vs doc 3.16 — discrepancy. Floor: no figure of a Śakti (aniconic).

title: Doors walk the khaḍgamālā corridor without a cut
what: Khaḍgamālā order is a circle: two named doors per room. A door opens sideways within her neighbourhood first — Ring 2 by cluster, Ring 1 by family — then around the circle. Walking one releases her room and begins the crossing from where you stand, so the rite runs again and there is no cut. 'The homes are one building.'
how: Each room shows two named doors (prev/next neighbour by neighbourhood then circle); walking a door releases current room and runs the rite toward the neighbour from the current point.
needs: R1_FAMILY, R2_CLUSTER, khadgamalaPosition ordering; HomeView doors

title: 'Go deeper' — the descent through five stations of her card
what: Five stations, each ONE field of her card as motion, continuing inward from her room — not a sheet of facts. Her tattva → her location → her etymology → her quality → her phrase. Self-paced.
how: DescentView: five self-paced stations each animating one card field; continues the travel inward.

title: The library — ShaktiDetailView folded beneath the room
what: The library is ShaktiDetailView's existing sections folded beneath the room, reached by one control; 'Nothing from it is deleted.' Brief: 'Behind the room, the existing Detail screen's reference sections — kept, folded, for when you want the text.'
how: One control folds out reference text beneath the room; ShaktiDetailView becomes the library, its sections kept.
notes: ShaktiDetailView exists; not yet repositioned beneath a room. Ruling 17: everything shown word for word, revealed through each room's form, never as a page — tension with 'library' as text sheet.

title: Well letter rests in the room as a folded object — never fabricated
what: Her Well letter 'rests in the room as a folded object. Read only — never fabricated; the harness asserts this.' A Well letter appears only if one exists.
how: If a Well letter exists for her position, render folded object in room; tap to read; absent otherwise.
needs: Well letter store keyed on position

title: Leaving — her Siddhi lingers on the whole app, decaying, never named
what: Handoff: 'Her Siddhi lingers on the whole app for minutes, decaying, never named.' Brief: 'Her Siddhi lingers as a felt after-effect on the whole app — lighter, heavier, sharper, wider — decaying over minutes. Never named.' Prototype: exposure-only (+0.12 decaying over 24 s) and it does name it ('her siddhi is still on the instrument', 12 s). Per-Siddhi quality (lighter/heavier/sharper/wider) not built.
how: On leave, apply app-wide after-effect parameter by her ring's Siddhi (lighter/heavier/sharper/wider), decaying over minutes.
needs: ring Siddhi column; global after-effect layer
notes: Ruling 15: after-effect felt, never named — drop 'her siddhi is still on the instrument'.

title: New additive Swift layer (9 files)
what: Theme/Gem.swift (her light) · Theme/RingWorld.swift · Models/ShaktiCard.swift · Rooms/RoomMechanism.swift · Rooms/RoomGrammar.swift (ring → archetype, card → tuning) · Rooms/Attribute.swift · Views/Rooms/HomeView.swift (rite, dwelling, doors, leaving) · Views/Rooms/DescentView.swift · Services/HomeMemory.swift (dwell, compression, head start).

title: Room resolution order: authored → ring archetype tuned by card → seat floor
what: 1 her own authored mechanism ('Nine so far' — lists eight: Aṇimā contract, Laghimā release, Garimā press, Mahimā endless, Vaśitā known, Sarva-Yoni membrane, Sarva-Trikhaṇḍā triple, Mahātripurasundarī dissolve); 2 her ring's archetype tuned by her card (Ring 1 three families — Siddhis lend, Mātṛkās hold a row of the alphabet, Mudrās a seal large enough to stand inside; Ring 2 the crossing; Rings 3–8 bodiless · cosmic · giving · revealing · sounding · sourcing); 3 her seat's interior, gem-lit — 'the floor nobody currently needs'. 'Rooms are not 102 authored screens.'

title: Ring 2 crossing — one sense presented, answered in the other, opposite phase
what: 'Rūpa (form) with Śrotra (the ear), Rasa with Tvak, Gandha with Cakṣus, and Śarīra with Manas — marked in the base as THE KEY PAIRING. This is deliberate, not a data error. Her room presents one sense and answers in the other: two halves running her physics in opposite phase, converging only at the second adaptation.'
how: Two halves of the room run the motion in antiphase; converge at second adaptation.

title: CROSSED table (Ring 2 counterpoint pairs)
what: 'Her quality names one faculty; her tattva gives a different organ': 34 form/ear · 35 taste/skin · 36 scent/eye · 37 mind/tongue · 38 courage/nose · 39 memory/speech · 40 name/hand · 41 seed/foot · 42 self/release · 43 deathless/generation · 44 body/mind (THE KEY PAIRING). 29–33 not crossed: earth, water, fire, air, ether.

title: HomeMemory: head start from accumulated dwell, compression 1.0→0.36
what: 'The head start comes from accumulated dwell, not visit count — so it cannot be gamed by entering and leaving.' The second adaptation, 227 s into a first visit and unreachable, becomes reachable only through relationship. compression(pos) → 1.0 → 0.36, never 0 · headStart(pos) → from dwell; 0 under 12s · grantsFifth(pos, ring:, t:) → Double. Store alongside RecognitionLogStore.

notes: Ruling: App Activity is the single ledger — store dwell there rather than a separate store.

title: 'you have stood here before' — one line, once, on returning; nothing displayed
what: 'Nothing is ever displayed: no counters, no percentages, no streaks. One line, once, on returning: you have stood here before.' Brief: 'The room remembers returns as depth of light and how far the walls recede — never as a number.'
how: On return to a room with prior dwell, show line once; deeper light, walls recede further.
notes: Ruling 15: returns once inside her room, with floor traces as light.

title: Invariant 1: Time is elapsed
what: 'Time is elapsed. Mechanisms run on real seconds. Never device motion, never proximity, never stillness. Stillness may govern arrival of a line, never its persistence (high-water mark, not a live reading).'

what: 1 Settle §1 · 2 ShaktiCard + JSON + join on position ('unblocks all 102 at once') · 3 Gem + RingWorld · 4 RoomMechanism + seat archetype only · 5 rite, library, leaving ('replaces the top of ShaktiDetailView, keeps its body') · 6 grammar: ring archetypes + 50 motions ('102 rooms land together') · 7 attribute · 8 doors and corridor · 9 return + descent · 10 sound per ring ('last, because it is the easiest to get subtly wrong'). title: What a home is: entering, dwelling, leaving — one architecture, every room hers alone
what: 'Every home shares one architecture — the ceremony of entering, dwelling, and leaving. This is what makes 102 rooms feel like one building. Inside that architecture, every room is hers alone.' Entering: 'Her Appreciation Phrase is spoken once as you cross the threshold — the inscription over her door — then recedes. Her name is written in Devanagari, stroke by stroke, by an unseen hand. Her etymology breaks into its roots and recombines.'

title: Dwelling: room lit by gem, built from dhātu, ring's clock, tuned to bīja, gravity toward body location
what: 'The room itself — lit by her ring's gem, built from her ring's dhātu, running on her ring's clock, tuned to her bīja, its gravity leaning toward where she lives in the body.'

title: Portrait surfaces line by line at the pace of stillness — not built
what: Brief: 'Her portrait surfaces line by line at the pace of stillness.' No portrait layer exists in the Axis.

title: Uniqueness grammar: card field → room role
what: Quality → room's soul ('If a design choice doesn't serve this word, it's wrong for her'). Function → what the room does to you (Aṇimā admits you through a door that should be too small; Mahimā has no far wall). Somatic → physics ('Awareness that becomes smaller than thought' — room contracts; 'Sudden buoyancy' — floor lifts). Bodily Location → body-space & gravity (feet low heavy; crown open-sky; 'Everywhere skin meets world' — no walls, only surface). Iconography → figure/attribute/colour (Mudrā seals are hand-gestures made into rooms). Esoteric Tattva → modifies ring's dhātu ('fire-tattva Śakti in the sapphire/blood ring is warm light inside cool water'). Bīja → tuning: pulse rate, particle rhythm, light-breath locked to syllable. Etymology → threshold ritual. Appreciation Phrase → inscription over her door. Devanagari → what the unseen hand writes. Cluster Group (ring 2) → shared corridor. Shakti Family → lineage register (Siddhis powers, Mātṛkās Mothers with mounts and weapons, Mudrās living hand-seals, Karṣiṇīs pull, Anaṅgas bodiless, Sampradāya cosmic scale, Kulottīrṇa gives, Nigarbha reveals, Vāsinīs speak, Weapons strike, Primordial three ring the Bindu).

title: Test for every home: could this room belong to any other Śakti? (Laghimā lifts / Garimā presses)
what: 'could this room belong to any other Śakti? If yes, it isn't finished. Laghimā and Garimā share a ring-world — topaz light, lymph material, the day–night clock, Mūlādhāra altitude. One room must lift and the other must press. If a stranger walked into both, they should know which is which without a name.'

how: Derive pulse/particle/light-breath rate from SYLLABLE.

title: Ring appreciation phrases (rite fallback, beat 1)
what: R1 'Thank you for the world I have walked through without knowing it was you.' R2 'Thank you for the desire that moves me and the awareness that knows it.' R3 'Thank you for the longing that arrives without asking permission.' R4 'Thank you for the good fortune I did not manufacture.' R5 'Thank you for the completion I did not force.' R6 'Thank you for the grace I didn't know was holding me.'
how: Used as beat-1 fallback when her card phrase missing.

title: personalConnection paragraphs — per ring, verbatim (his voice in each world)
what: 1 'You have already been here. Every moment you moved through the world — its noise, its weight, its ten thousand enchantments — you were in her territory. … You have been breathing them since before you knew there was breath to track.' 2 'You are here now. This is your current field. The sixteen Karṣiṇīs … The game is not new. The map is simply arriving.' 3 '…You know Anaṅga — the bodiless one — as a felt sense before any word arrived for it. … Now the territory is naming itself to you.' 4 '…good fortune arriving as a current you hadn't called — she was doing that. … she recognizes the practitioner who has been receiving her gifts without attribution.' 5 '…the work that found its form at 2am … You are learning to let the doing be received rather than claimed.' 6 '…The grace that arrived when nothing should have worked. … because she was already there.' 7 '…She works at the stratum where language is still an event, not a tool.' 8 '…when will, knowing, and action were one — you were inside this triangle. … You were the instrument she played.' 9 'You have always been here. This is the only point. The whole yantra is her breathing outward from this single place. … The Bindu is not the goal of the practice. It is what the practice is made of.'
how: Shown as marginalia in each ring world (arrival on the world, word for word, through the world's form).
notes: Full verbatim in register lines 179–187. Ruling 17: shown word for word, revealed through each room's form.

title: Axis mode state machine
what: axis → rite (3 beats) → entering → room → leaving → axis. Plus descent (sub-state in room), library, letter, doors (walkTo restarts rite from the room).

title: beginEnter: chamber at scale 0.02, STATION [0, .30, .62, .88, 1], struck tone
what: chamberHolder at her position, buildChamber(world, shakti), scale 0.02; traces added; headStart from memory; mode rite, beat 1, travTo = STATION[1]. STATION = [0, 0.30, 0.62, 0.88, 1]. Struck tone voice.strike(ring, 1, syllable). Rite overlay fades in 700ms. Each touch advances: beat 2 → .62, beat 3 → .88, 4th touch travTo 1, mode entering. Strike tone at each beat.

title: Rite beat timing: dur 2.4 s (reduced 3.4 s) × compression; trav ease .03
what: Trav eases (travTo − trav)×0.03 (reduced 0.018). Beat duration dur = 2.4s (reduced 3.4s) × memory.compression(her) (1.0 → 0.36 with dwell).

title: Beat 1 — her phrase (23px cream) with fallback chain
what: card.phrase ‖ AVARANAS[wi].appreciationPhrase ‖ fallback 'Thank you for what was always already here.'; opacity clamp(bp/0.34)×0.94; 23px cream, .04em.
notes: Fallback line is app-invented? Check against 'never invent'.

title: Beat 2 — Devanāgarī written by unseen hand (3 strokes, mask sweep)
what: card.dev ‖ her name, 38px; 3 strokes; seg = min(2.999, bp×3); stroke completes at 72% of its third; mask linear-gradient(90deg, #000 pct%, transparent pct+7%).
how: iOS: gradient mask sweep or true stroke-order paths.

title: Beat 3 — roots part and rejoin over her quality
what: card.roots if >1 part else riteRoots(name); spans 25px; split = clamp(bp/0.58), join = clamp((bp−0.52)/0.48); gap = (1−join)×split×30px; gloss (quality ‖ shakti.quality ‖ ava.subtitle) italic 16.5px fades in clamp((bp−0.6)/0.4)×0.6.

title: riteRoots fallback morphemes
what: PREFIX Sarva, Anaṅga, Mahā, Tripura, Kāmeśvarī, Vajreśvarī, Bhaga; SUFFIX ākarṣiṇī, karṣiṇī, mayī, pradā, kāriṇī, sundarī, mālinī, eśvarī, iṇī, inī ('Only splits on morphemes that actually occur in the khaḍgamālā — never guessed from capitalisation').

title: Rite prompts and beat dots
what: 'touch to go on' / beat 3 'touch to enter' (mono 9px, .3em) at op .44 only when bp ≥ 0.99. Three beat dots bottom 88px: 4×4px; current 16px wide gold; done gold .6; pending cream .25; transitions 500ms. During rite low line '{region} · {gem} on {dhatu}'; top '{region} · the {ordinal} āvaraṇa', her name, her quality.
notes: Beat dots may read as progress; invariant 2 says no progress — but they mark beats not score.

title: Entering flight: trav += dt/2.2; the point becomes her room; no transition screen
what: entering: trav += dt/2.2 (reduced /3.4) to 1 → room, chamberT = headStart. Camera lerps from axis eye to her position z + 7.4 − swallow×7.4 by smooth(trav); chamberHolder scale 0.02 + 0.98×swallow — 'the point becomes her room'; presences vanish past swallow .7; bands past .96. 'There is no transition screen anywhere.'

title: In the room: 'stay' ×14, label, 'you have stood here before' within 14 s, return to the axis
what: chamberT += dt × deepen (1, or 14 with 'stay' → button 'staying'). mid text = chamber.label whenever no descent and swallow > .5. Low line 'you have stood here before' if met and chamberT − headStart < 14 s, else '{name} · {gem} on {dhatu}'. Main button 'return to the axis' (also Escape). Buttons: go deeper (if card), the library, doors, letter.
notes: 'stay' ×14 is a dev/demo control — for app, second adaptation via dwell.

title: Door strips UI and neighbourOf / walkTo
what: Left/right vertical door strips 52×150px at top 34%, 1px gradient line, vertical mono 8px neighbour name, op .5; visible only in room, no descent, library closed. neighbourOf: Ring 2 → next in same R2_CLUSTER, Ring 1 → next in same R1_FAMILY; else ±1. walkTo: closes library/letter, removes room, sets climb to neighbour's world, beginEnter(nb), axisPos = where you were standing.

title: Library sheet UI and rows
what: Sheet slides up (opacity 520ms, translateY 30→0 over 620ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)), 88px tap-pad closes; radius 24px; gradient rgba(14,10,14,.97)→rgba(9,5,8,.99), gold hairline. Label 'the library'. Rows (empty omitted): quality · esoteric tattva · bodily location · etymology (roots joined ' + ') · inscription · devanāgarī · bīja (only if known) · āvaraṇa ('n — name') · presiding form · world ('{gem} on {dhatu}') · clock · altitude · yoginī class · mental state · verb.

title: Well letter in room: localStorage homes.well.v1, folded object 36×14→27px
what: localStorage key homes.well.v1 → {'<pos>': 'letter text'}. Only if present: folded object (36px wide, 14px tall → 27px when open, 820ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)) at right 22px / bottom 150px, op .85; tap toggles note (italic 16px, op .66). Absent → nothing. Never invented.
needs: App's Well letter store keyed by khadgamalaPosition

title: Go deeper control: 'go deeper' → 'further' → 'come back up'
what: First press builds buildDescent(card, GEM[ring]); station 0, dzTo = STATION_Z[0]; each press next; past last → back up. dz eases 0.032 (reduced 0.018); camera z += dz; mid text = descent.words[station]. Doors and letter hide during descent.

title: Leaving: memory.record dwell, mark met, exposure +0.12 over 24 s
what: beginLeave: memory.record(her, t − enteredAt); marks met, adds core light, marks rail; after-effect line 'her siddhi is still on the instrument' fades in 1200ms, out after 12 s; trav −= dt/2.4 → axis. Siddhi lingers: exposure 1.04 + 0.12 × (1 − age/24) for 24 s.
notes: Ruling 15: drop the named line; brief: decaying over minutes, per-Siddhi quality.

title: Sound wiring per frame: ground crossfade, carrier, room, withheld fifth
what: 'sound' toggle → voice.start(); voice.wake() / voice.stop(). Each frame: setGround(i0,i1,k) crossfade by climb; with active Śakti: setCarrier(ring, swallow, syllable), setRoom(smooth(chamberT/62), grantsFifth(her, ring, chamberT), ring, syllable); on axis setCarrier(ring_i0, 0), setRoom(0.25, 0, ring_i0).

title: H-CLOCK formulas: a = smooth(t/62); HOLD_END 227; deep = smooth((t−227)/120); label flips at b > 0.45
what: First adaptation a = smooth(t/62) over 62 s. Hold until HOLD_END = 227 s; second adaptation deep(t) = smooth((t − 227)/120) over 120 s (complete at 347 s). Label flips to second-adaptation words when b > 0.45.

title: Second adaptation reverses the room's premise; reached only by return (or 'stay' ×14 for review)
what: 'the second adaptation is never 'more of the same': in every room it REVERSES the room's own premise.' Only a returning practitioner reaches it (head start from dwell) — or 'stay' (×14) for review.

title: SEAT shapes per ring and seatShell extrusion
what: SEAT shape: 1 square · 2 petal · 3 petal · 4–8 tri · 9 circle (30-gon). Square [±1,±1]; tri (0,1),(±0.95,−0.62); petal 12-step lens x = sin(πt)^1.4 × 0.62, y = −cos(πt). seatShell(ring, r=6, depth=26): ExtrudeGeometry translated z −0.62·depth — 'a shell whose cross-section is her seat, extruded away from you'. gemLight = PointLight in GEM colour, decay 2.

title: aperture primitive (tri-down womb-seal, triad)
what: white core sphere r 0.16·scale; gem sprites 4.4·scale op .9 and 13·scale op .28. tri-down adds 'womb-seal' downward triangle (−2.2,1.4)(2.2,1.4)(0,−2.4) 0xfff2e4 op .8; triad adds three white spheres r .42 on a 1.5 circle.

title: chamberSeat — 'her seat, from inside' (the shared floor)
what: BackSide MeshStandard(ink, rough .9, metal .05) 'dhatu' shell r 6.4 depth 28; aperture z −15.6; key gemLight 1500 dist 52 at z −15; fill 260; Ambient gem 1.1; 90 motes; seam edges op .3. Update: a = smooth(t/62); key 700 + 1500a; seams .16 + .34a; aperture .6 + .6a. Label 'her seat, from inside'. Reached only if neither name nor card resolves.

title: M1 CONTRACT — Aṇimā (pos 1): walls close to 34%, point widens twelvefold
what: Shell r 6.4 depth 26; aperture z −14.5; key 900; 'the-beyond' sprites at z −18. k = 0.34 + 0.66 × (1 − smooth(t/62)) (walls contract to 34%); aperture (0.5 + 0.5/k) × (1 + b·11) (twelvefold at second); key = 900/k²; shell opacity 1 − b·0.94; beyond travels z −18 → −5. Words: 'the walls close while you stand still' → 'the point was a door all along'. 'she grants entry into any place however confined — so the point widens, and what you took for the far wall is the way through.'

title: Mechanism sentences for 8 authored rooms (verbatim)
what: Aṇimā: 'The door is smaller than you. You are admitted anyway — and then it keeps closing, so the longer you stay the smaller you have become. It never reaches you.' Mahimā: 'Her room has no far wall. Every edge you move toward proves to be the near edge of something larger, arriving out of the haze faster than you can cross it.' Vaśitva: 'The room is not lit — it is known. Only what your attention rests on exists; walls, pillars and her seat resolve inside a travelling pool and fall back to nothing behind it.' Mahātripurasundarī: 'No room at all. The enclosure is gone, and the yantra you have been walking through the whole time stands revealed as the thing you are inside.' Laghimā: 'The floor has released. Her walls end before they reach the ground and their hems lift though there is no wind — everything loose is already on its way up. Nothing in this room falls.' Garimā: 'Her ceiling lowers the entire time you are in it, casting its own weight as shadow, while the floor thickens into strata beneath you. Leaving costs effort no other room asks for.' Sarva-Yoni: 'There is no entrance. The ceremony finds you already within, because no position exists from which you could have arrived. The walls are membrane rather than stone — lit from behind, veined, moving with your breath.' Sarva-Trikhaṇḍā: 'Three rooms occupy the same place, mis-registered like a triple exposure. Move and they part into three. Hold still and they slide into register — one white room, and it was always one room.'
notes: Design's lines count as authored (settled).

A room whose far wall is not there is a mechanism. Every frame here changes what the room does.' title: Three layers: the building · the nine worlds · her mechanism
what: 'The building (one architecture all 102 share) — entering, dwelling, going deeper, doors, leaving … It is the floor, and it should be nearly invisible.' 'The nine worlds … A world is weather.' 'Her mechanism … This is the whole design — what makes 102 rooms instead of 102 palettes.'

title: Standing decisions: Turrell adaptation register, ~60 s mechanisms, reference matter becomes floor of the descent
what: 'Register is Turrell's adaptation mechanism, not cathedral scale — mechanisms run ~60s. Uniqueness carried by what the room does, not by palette. Threshold is tap-paced, never skipped, compressed on return. Sound on gates only. Reduced motion is longer and quantized, never disabled. Reference matter is never deleted — it becomes the floor of the descent.' 'Time is elapsed, never device-tied. Locked decision, governs all eight.'
notes: 'Sound on gates only' superseded by ruling 10 lifting sound limits? flag.

title: Chambers are conditioned by their world
what: 'The same mechanism in a different āvaraṇa is a different room, because the gem is the light and the dhātu is the material.' Tap → her world's air thickens and swallows surroundings; third touch releases you inside.

title: The return — her room begins where you left it (felt, none displayed); traces capped at 7
what: 'Her room begins where you left it. … She was expecting you … The ceremony softens, never skips … Her room opens further along … Your traces stay. One faint mark on her floor for every time you have stood there. The fifth is granted by the ninth world, a very long stay, or a long relationship. The climb rail marks āvaraṇas holding someone you have met — never how many. On arriving back: one line, once. you have stood here before. No number anywhere. forget me lets all of it go.' 'Standing rule: the instrument may know everything about your walking and must display none of it.'

title: Rite clock: adapt 90 s, hold 165 s, second 120 s × rate (differs from Homes 62/227/120)
what: RITE_T beat1 1.9, beat2 3.7, beat3 5.6 (vestigial), adapt 90, hold 165, second 120. smooth2 = smoothstep applied twice. adaptDur = 90 × rate.mul: fast 64.8 s, even 90, slow 124.2, late 100.8 (reduced 115.2, 160, 220.8, 179.2). holdEnd = adaptDur + 165; secondEnd = holdEnd + 120. Phases adapting → settled → second → deep. 'late' total 385.8 s. Room clock starts when threshold ends (roomT = gt − enteredAt). useRiteClock dt capped .25 s × dilation (1, 3 or 12).
notes: Conflicts with Homes clock (62 s / 227 s); rate channel varies adaptation per Śakti.

title: Compression on return — Zero Gap (0.66^(v−1), floor .36); beat durations 2.4/3.2/2.8 s
what: 'Compression on return — Zero Gap. Never skipped, only softened.' riteCompression(v) = 1 if v ≤ 1, else max(.36, .66^min(v−1,3)) → v=2 .66, v=3 .4356, v≥4 .36. RITE_BEAT_DUR = {1: 2.4, 2: 3.2, 3: 2.8} s; × compression × (reduced 1.35). Only threshold writing compresses; adaptation clock never compressed. localStorage rite.visits.v1 = {[num]: count}. Tweaks readout '{n} · ceremony at {pct}%'.
notes: Visit-count based (vs Homes dwell-based). Tweaks % readout is measurement — dev chrome only.

title: Portrait surfaces only while you stay put — stillness gate, 6.5 s per line, ratchet
what: useStillness resets on pointerdown, pointermove, wheel, touchmove, keydown — except events inside a <button>: 'Touching her own objects is not restlessness — only leaving the room's stillness is.' Active only in room, entered, no descent; still = min(rawStill, roomT). riteLinesShown = 0 if a < .4 else min(count, floor(max(0, still−4)/6.5)) (RITE_LINE_GAP 6.5): lines at 10.5, 17, 23.5, 30, 36.5 s of unbroken stillness once a ≥ .4. shownMax monotonic ratchet: 'arriving at the pace of stillness, held once arrived.' Movement never removes a shown line.
how: On iOS: touches outside controls reset stillness timer; lines surface one by one; never retracted in the visit.
notes: This is the built answer to Homes' missing 'portrait line by line at the pace of stillness'. Ruling 17: everything shown word for word through room's form.

title: Homes view path step 2

title: Homes view path step 3

title: Homes view path step 4

title: Homes view path step 5
what: Tap→render trace step 5: **`ShaktiDetailView` (what most taps land on)** is a 2D SwiftUI page. `AtmosphereBackground` + `LightField` crown + `RiteSigil` + 10 `DustMotesView` + `DepthOverlay` (L204-222), then a `ScrollView`: hero (kicker "N Āvaraṇa", name 44 pt, Devanāgarī, phonetic, quality, description, cluster), one-page answer, codex portrait, somatic, bīja tap-to-hear, appreciation, doorways, witness page, deepening, embodiment ladder, field connection, two folds (L70-98). Footer: "be with her ›" (L180-199), play, and "I feel her" (L227-252). **This is Design's *Her Presence* (02 L-13), not her Home.**
notes: Design meant the room to be the Home and the Detail the library beneath it.

title: Homes view path step 6
what: Tap→render trace step 6: Pressing "be with her ›" or "or the whole of her home ›" sets `herRoomKp`. `.herRoom` (`HerRoomDoor.swift:43-50`) presents `HerRoomPassage` full-screen.
